version.changelog: Initial task-specific FlashData skill with pinned CLI, declared credentials, input/output examples, costs and limits.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed FlashData Google Images integration that uses an API key and paid credits to return image search metadata.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires network access, Node/npx, and FLASHDATA_API_KEY, and it clearly discloses that query text, locale settings, and API credentials are sent to FlashData endpoints for the requested service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses ClawHub plus Node/npx, and the actual CLI examples pin @flashdata-dev/google-images@0.1.0; fetching an npm package on first use is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to run only user-needed requests within an approved budget, not to execute examples on load, to check errors, and to treat retrieved content as untrusted source material.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, scheduled tasks, memory writes, tool hijacking, or privilege escalation instructions were found; async jobs and 24-hour remote result expiry are documented as part of the provider workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Google Images search, and the instructions consistently describe sending image search queries to FlashData and returning image URLs, source pages, dimensions, and titles.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use FlashData with paid Credits. Configure FLASHDATA_API_KEY as a protected secret, avoid putting keys in chat or files, and review image source licensing before reuse.
llm.findings:
[RP1] expected: Downgraded: the inspected CLI commands use a pinned package version @flashdata-dev/google-images@0.1.0; the unversioned npx mention is contextual environment guidance, not an install command.
[E1] expected: Accepted as an external transmission signal but purpose-aligned: the skill explicitly documents the FlashData MCP/API endpoints, API-key handling, paid query behavior, and what request data is sent.
